title: Invoicing and margins: prepared, not typed
description: Invoices prepared from approved hours, milestones and expenses, sent through your accounting tool. Margin per project while the work runs.
teaser: Invoices prepared from approved work, margins per project while it runs.
h1: Invoices prepared for you, margins you see in time
lead: When a billing moment comes, the billing owner gets the invoice ready to check: client, terms and lines filled in from approved hours, milestones and expenses. Your accounting tool still numbers, sends and books it. And you see each project's margin while the work is running.

features.title: Every way you bill
features.text: Fixed price by milestone or schedule, time and materials, or a monthly retainer. Implesta signals each billing moment and never invoices on its own.

features.title: Prepared, then sent from your accounting tool
features.text: Lines come from approved time, reached milestones and rebillable expenses, minus what was already invoiced. You check it, and it goes to your accounting tool as a draft. Connected today: {accountingTools}.

screen.describes: A prepared invoice ready to send

features.title: Receivables at a glance
features.text: What is outstanding, what is overdue and by how long, per client and per project.

features.title: Margin while the work runs
features.text: Revenue against the cost of the hours worked and the expenses, per project and across the portfolio, against each project's target margin.

signals.text: Money moments reach the people who can act on them.

items.title: Prepare invoice: Packaging line commissioning
